name: Jarvis WhatsApp Forwarder
description: Forwards WhatsApp inbound events to Jarvis and silences OpenClaw auto replies for WhatsApp.

endpoint.label: Jarvis inbound endpoint
endpoint.help: Local Jarvis endpoint that receives normalized WhatsApp inbound events.

blockOpenClawReplies.label: Silence OpenClaw WhatsApp replies
blockOpenClawReplies.help: When enabled, Jarvis receives inbound WhatsApp events but OpenClaw does not answer them directly.
